::: {#perfil}

He was a deep learning researcher at the GAIA Lab, applying computer vision to satellite data for biodiversity monitoring in the Amazon. He holds an MSc in Mathematical Modeling and a BSc in Data Science and AI, both from FGV EMAp. He works as a generative AI engineer at Dharma AI, building LLM agents and fine-tuning models.

## Education

- MSc in Mathematical Modeling (ESG applications) — FGV EMAp, 2024–2025
- BSc in Data Science and AI — FGV EMAp, 2020–2023

## Interests

Remote sensing, computer vision, LLM agents, and data engineering.
